about_the_game:
100 Men vs 1 Gorilla is a chaotic battle royale style multiplayer game where a single overpowered gorilla faces off against a swarm of one hundred fragile, screaming humans. Will teamwork and sheer numbers win out—or will the gorilla turn the arena into a banana-scented bloodbath?

Welcome to 100 Men vs 1 Gorilla: the ultimate test to settle the debate once and for all.

FEATURES

🦍 100 and 1 Multiplayer
Play as the unstoppable gorilla or one of 100 brave, poorly coordinated humans. Team up with strangers or friends in an all-out war against the mighty Silverback Gorilla.

🎮 High intensity Combat
Can 200 fists defeat a Gorilla or is the Gorilla too strong for 100 tiny human men? It's all out mayhem with high intensity combat.

🧠 Herd Mentality
''Ape together strong'' - Human

🌴 Arena Madness
Battle on an open field and fight for domination. Watch people get launched into the stratosphere by a gorilla body slam, or get pummeled by mighty gorilla fists.

🎤 Meme-Ready Chaos
Screaming voices in voice chat. Cinematic battles. And enough bodies to crash your grandma’s laptop.

Whether you're flinging fools as the GORILLAAAHH or trying to be the one human who actually lands a hit—100 Men vs. 1 Gorilla is the absurd brawler you absolutely knew you needed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 @2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 770 or AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: May work with even lower specs
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 @3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: May work with even lower specs
